app_concept: BEC Progress Assistant - A premium, interactive Business English Certificate coaching tool and analytics dashboard. It combines an immersive recording interface for speaking/writing practice with a high-density analytics dashboard for tracking grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation over time.

typography.strategy: The 'Swiss Brutalist' paired with technical precision. Avoid generic 'Inter' for headings. Use geometric, authoritative fonts for a professional business certificate tool.

scale.ipa_phonetics: text-sm font-mono tracking-wide text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md

colors.archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + Actionable Educational Accents
rules: Use high-contrast monochrome (Black/White/Grey) for structural elements.
Use specific accent colors ONLY for language feedback: Red for grammar errors, Green for correct pronunciation/IPA, Violet for vocabulary suggestions, Blue for fluency.
Never use pure black or pure gray; tint grays slightly.

layouts.spacing_system: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Use gap-6 or gap-8 between major sections.
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text and data. Center-align only the main recording UI and high-level marketing headers.
layouts.header: Sticky top, z-50, crystal glassmorphism (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border/40).

recording_ui.style: Neumorphic or 'Tracing Beam' inspired. Use concentric nested radii and pulsing glow animations when active.

feedback_cards.style: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Go cardless where possible. Use border-collapse style layouts with 1px border-r border-b to expose the structure and make it feel analytical.

ipa_badges.style: Pill-shaped, monospace font, subtle background tint matching the feedback type (e.g., green for good pronunciation).

buttons.primary: bg-zinc-900 text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 transition-all shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-zinc-900 border border-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-50 rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 transition-all

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Mix 'Grid Borders' for the analytics dashboard with 'Glassmorphism' for sticky headers and modals.

motion.interactions: Hover states must explicitly set text and background color (e.g. hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-900). Buttons should have a slight lift (-translate-y-[1px]).
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-[transform,opacity,background-color] duration-200 ease-out. DO NOT use 'transition-all'.
motion.recording_animation: Use a subtle scale and opacity keyframe animation for the recording pulse.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain 4.5:1 ratio for standard text. Never use gray-on-gray for vital feedback.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-zinc-900 focus:outline-none.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='start-recording-btn').

speaking_module_banner.description: A woman standing in front of a projector screen giving a presentation. Use for the Speaking Practice entry point or hero section.

writing_module_banner.description: Person sitting in front of laptop. Use for the Writing Practice entry point.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts (recharts under the hood) for dashboard analytics. 3D is overkill for a data-dense linguistic dashboard. Keep it flat, 2D, and highly legible.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install recommended fonts via Google Fonts (Outfit, Manrope, JetBrains Mono) in index.html.
Install lucide-react for standard icons. Use phosphor-icons for deeper, analytical icons if necessary.
Set up a layout with a fixed sidebar or top navigation, and a main content area using the Bento grid for analytics.
For the speaking practice view, create a highly focused UI with a large, animated record button. Split the results into tabs or grid cards: Grammar, Word Choice, and Pronunciation.
Implement the IPA display using the 'ipa_phonetics' scale from typography guidelines. Example: /prəˌnʌn.siˈeɪ.ʃən/
Use Shadcn components for complex interactions (Dropdowns, Dialogs, Tabs) but heavily customize their padding and borders to match the Swiss Grid aesthetic.
Always append `data-testid` to buttons, inputs, and major sections.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in CSS.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭) for icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
